rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice when someone has no money available, with the context supplying the absolute sense.

example.english: I'm penniless today, so I can't afford the bus.
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 zan1 hai6 mou5 cin2 daap3 ce1

rows.note: Use this when you want to stress that the person has not even the smallest amount of money.

example.traditional: 佢離開嗰個城市時，身無分文。
example.jyutping: keoi5 lei4 hoi1 go2 go3 sing4 si5 si4 san1 mou4 fan1 man4

rows.note: Use this colloquial emphatic phrase when stressing that the person does not even have one dollar.

example.english: I only realized I was penniless after leaving home.
example.traditional: 我出門口先發現自己一蚊都冇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ceot1 mun4 hau2 sin1 faat3 jin6 zi6 gei2 jat1 man1 dou1 mou5
